structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Modes of Transportation: Highways, Bridges, Ferries, Rail, and Public Transportation

law.catch_line: Sections 33.2-606 through 33.2-609 not applicable to certain toll bridges
law.text: Nothing contained in §§ 33.2-606 through 33.2-609 shall be construed to apply to any bridge existing or under construction on March 20, 1928, or to bridges constructed within or adjacent to towns or cities having a population of more than 3,500.
